work_info.title: What is Web Development?
descriptions: Web Development is the process of designing and building functional, responsive, and high-performance websites tailored to business goals. It focuses on creating fast, secure, and user-friendly websites that deliver seamless experiences across devices.

list.content: Frontend & Backend Development: Building interactive interfaces supported by robust server logic.
Responsive Design Implementation: Ensuring compatibility across mobiles, tablets, and desktops.
Performance & Speed Optimization: Developing websites that load quickly and run smoothly.
Security & Data Protection: Implementing best practices to safeguard user information.
SEO-Friendly Structure: Structuring websites for better visibility on search engines.
